# Vendored PluginBridge SDK

`rokid-prism-pluginbridge-plugin-sdk-0.1.4.tgz` was generated from
`prism-sdk/node` with `npm test` followed by `npm pack`. Its SHA-256 is
`bb41d2137985b0fb9dc5fe109f6b293adb058db02fffb0facdd3b80f85f14be8`.
The package is fixed in `package-lock.json` so the plugin can run `npm ci` in
an isolated release checkout before SDK 0.1.4 is published to npm. Refresh it
after any SDK source change that affects this plugin.
